name: ALON Blockchain MCP Server
description: Real-time MCP server for multi-chain blockchain operations

tools.name: get_eth_balance
tools.description: Fetch Ethereum balance for any address using ethers.js

tools.name: send_eth_transaction
tools.description: Send ETH with optional conditional execution based on minimum balance

tools.name: get_sol_balance
tools.description: Fetch Solana balance for any address using @solana/web3.js

tools.name: send_sol_transaction
tools.description: Send SOL with optional conditional execution based on minimum balance

tools.name: multi_chain_summary
tools.description: Get aggregated balances across Ethereum and Solana for multiple addresses

inputs.addresses: Array of blockchain addresses (can be mixed ETH and SOL)

outputs.ethereum: Object with ETH addresses and their balances
outputs.solana: Object with SOL addresses and their balances

features: Real-time blockchain operations via MCP protocol
Live balance queries using real RPC endpoints
Not mocked - uses real ethers.js and @solana/web3.js

security.supabase: Optional logging, gracefully degrades if not configured
